title: 新武界引水隧道~New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel
focus: 引水能量、水文地質與TBM規劃整合~Conveyance energy, hydrogeology and TBM planning integration
summary: 台電典藏說明新武界及栗栖溪引水工程的規劃與施工，列16.5公里引水範圍及其中6.5公里TBM中段，記錄2002年該掘進段貫通。本課把土木、地質與水力目的串接，研究水路能量、探查代表性、支護和施工物流；這些尺度不被混寫成單一孔全長或發電容量。~Taipower describes planning and construction for New Wujie and Lixi conveyance, including a 16.5 km scope and a 6.5 km TBM middle section that broke through in 2002. This course connects civil, geological and hydraulic purposes through energy, investigation, support and logistics, without confusing those scopes with one bore length or generating capacity.

units.anchor: 水體平流時間~Water advection time
units.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間~Underground water routes and travel time
units.mechanism: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。~New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time. Distance divided by velocity estimates constant-speed material travel, while flood-wave celerity, storage and backwater alter signal propagation. Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=22.2222 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為24.4444 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 24.4444 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。~Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival.
units.misconception: 水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。~Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
units.practice: 本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1035.94 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1035.94 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 公開資料的最高日進尺與月平均是不同統計量，本課以新武界背景重建班次利用率而非追逐紀錄。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Published peak daily and mean monthly advance are different statistics; reconstruct shift utilisation rather than treating a production record as normal. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.98 m/h；有效利用率=0.295 無因次。D=24vu=14.0184 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為15.4202 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.98 m/h; utilisation=0.295 dimensionless. D=24vu=14.0184 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 15.4202 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將最高日、完整月份與停機日納入同一時間帳。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Include peak day, full month and stoppage days in one time balance. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 最高日乘整月會系統性高估施工進度。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~Multiplying the peak day by a month systematically overstates progress. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：將最高日、完整月份與停機日納入同一時間帳。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Include peak day, full month and stoppage days in one time balance. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 引水隧道的初期支護先穩定開挖，永久內襯還有水理和耐久功能，教材明確區分兩者驗證。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Initial support stabilises excavation while permanent lining also serves hydraulics and durability; verify these functions separately. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=46 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=414 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為455.4 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=46 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=414 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 455.4 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 滿管沿程損失~Full-pipe friction loss
units.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界~Conveyance friction and transient boundaries
units.mechanism: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。~Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity. A steady full-pipe equation does not describe water hammer, free-surface transitions or trapped air. Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。~Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area.
units.misconception: 只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。~A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.01486 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.01486 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 平均直徑合格仍可能有局部縮頸造成額外損失。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Acceptable mean diameter can conceal local constrictions and excess loss. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 引水坡度微小時高程誤差可改變排水與淨空判讀，新武界教材強調共同高程基準。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~With small conveyance gradients, height errors alter drainage and clearance interpretation; maintain a common elevation reference. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4920 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0708429 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=4920 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0708429 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為206.699 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 206.699 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 水量帳與環境受體~Water balance and environmental receptors
units.mechanism: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。~Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction. A water balance needs explicit temporal and spatial boundaries; its residual cannot be assigned directly to one fracture. Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為63.8 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 63.8 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。~Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation.
units.misconception: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。~Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
units.practice: 本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。~For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate conveyance friction and transient boundaries. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2002 年公開記錄：台電記錄的中段TBM掘進於6月貫通。台電典藏說明新武界及栗栖溪引水工程的規劃與施工，列16.5公里引水範圍及其中6.5公里TBM中段，記錄2002年該掘進段貫通。本課把土木、地質與水力目的串接，研究水路能量、探查代表性、支護和施工物流；這些尺度不被混寫成單一孔全長或發電容量。本課把「引水能量、水文地質與TBM規劃整合」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2002: The documented middle-section TBM drive achieves breakthrough in June. Taipower describes planning and construction for New Wujie and Lixi conveyance, including a 16.5 km scope and a 6.5 km TBM middle section that broke through in 2002. This course connects civil, geological and hydraulic purposes through energy, investigation, support and logistics, without confusing those scopes with one bore length or generating capacity. The course treats conveyance energy, hydrogeology and tbm planning integration as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 6.5 km TBM middle section within 16.5 km conveyance scope，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 6.5 km TBM middle section within 16.5 km conveyance scope; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2002 年事件：台電記錄的中段TBM掘進於6月貫通。~2002 event: The documented middle-section TBM drive achieves breakthrough in June.

教學「水體平流時間」：水路長度=2000 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=22.2222 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching water advection time: reach length=2000 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 22.2222 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.001512 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=2e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.001512 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「支護安裝時點」：局部剛度=46 kN/mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=414 kN；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching support activation time: local stiffness=46 kN/mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 414 kN; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「滿管沿程損失」：達西因子=0.02 無因次，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1.83486 m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching full-pipe friction loss: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1.83486 m; not measured or accepted project data.
